selection: Among development candidates passing all gates, maximize all-required-evidence@5, then any-hit@5, then minimize noise rate, then prefer the largest floor.
validation_policy: Freeze product source and selected floor before first validation query; preserve the used marker and all original failures; never tune on consumed validation output.
annotation: Single author before product output. Synthetic topic-disjoint holdout, not independent human annotations or population-quality certification.
release_status: Does not replace the consumed v43 evaluation, its labels, or the original storage and release gates.
